生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's current weapon reference
for the physical weapon before activation.

Use the provided empowered weapon reference
as the visual target for the activated state.

The empowered state must preserve
the same physical weapon underneath.

Emerald-green runic energy surrounds
and extends the weapon into
a massive empowered greatsword silhouette.

The original physical weapon remains visible
inside the green energy.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the final frame from Scene 37
only for spatial continuity at the beginning.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Restrained performance.

Natural physical movement.

Strong realistic impact and body weight.

Emerald-green runic energy should feel powerful,
ancient, unstable, and physically present.

The energy is translucent,
with visible flowing rune patterns,
subtle particles,
and wind distortion.

Do not make it look like a clean laser blade.

Natural fire,
wind,
heavy breathing,
weapon impacts,
wood creaking,
and environmental sound.

No dialogue.
No subtitles.
No background music.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven has chosen to stand
between the Mysterious Dark Figure
and the escaping civilians.

The figure attacks again.

Riven blocks,
but the impact still forces her backward.

She nearly falls,
but refuses to leave her position.

Then something inside her weapon awakens.

Emerald-green runes begin activating
across the physical weapon.

Runic energy spreads around the blade
and expands into the empowered form.

The Mysterious Dark Figure attacks again.

This time Riven meets the attack
with the empowered weapon.

For the first time,

Riven is not pushed backward.

The impact forces the dark figure away instead.

End with both opponents separated
and facing each other,
ready for the final fight.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — SHE DOES NOT FALL ===

Open from a new low close angle on Riven.

Do not recreate
the exact final composition of Scene 37.


Riven is already standing.

She is injured and exhausted.

Her weapon is still
in its normal current state.


Ahead of her,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
begins moving.


Suddenly—

it rushes toward Riven
with unnatural speed.


Riven raises her weapon—

BLOCK.


HEAVY CLASH.


The force drives Riven backward.


Her boots slide
through dust and broken debris.


She nearly loses her balance.


But Riven refuses to fall.


She plants her feet
and stops herself.


Behind her,

the civilians are still escaping.


Riven briefly sees them.


She turns back toward
the Mysterious Dark Figure.


She remains standing.


=== SHOT 2 — BLADE OF THE EXILE ===

Move closer to Riven
and the weapon in her hands.


She is breathing heavily.


At first,

the weapon remains unchanged.


Then—


a single engraved rune
on the dark metal
emits a faint emerald-green light.


Riven notices it.


Another rune activates.


Then another.


Emerald light begins traveling
through the engraved channels
across the physical weapon.


The activation spreads gradually.


The green light becomes stronger.


Wind begins moving around Riven.


Ash and small embers
are pulled into the air around the weapon.


Emerald runic energy
begins flowing outward
from the physical blade.


The energy wraps around the weapon
without replacing it.


The original dark metal weapon
remains clearly visible inside.


More energy gathers.


The emerald energy expands
beyond the physical metal,

forming the silhouette
of a much larger greatsword.


Use the provided empowered weapon reference
as the visual target.


The empowered blade should feel massive
and ancient.


Dark physical metal remains at its core.


Bright emerald runes
burn across its surface.


Translucent green energy
forms the expanded outer blade.


Small fragments of green energy
and wind-like particles
move around its edges.


Riven slowly raises the weapon.


Green light reflects subtly
across her face and armor.


She looks at the transformed weapon
for only a brief moment.


She did not expect this.


Then Riven looks forward again.


=== SHOT 3 — THE BALANCE CHANGES ===

Across the smoke,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
faces Riven.


The figure suddenly rushes again.


Extremely fast.


Riven does not chase its movement.


She remains grounded.


She waits.


The dark rush closes the distance.


At the final moment—

Riven moves.


She brings the empowered green blade
into the attack.


CLASH.


A powerful burst
of emerald runic energy
erupts from the point of impact.


Wind and smoke
are pushed outward.


Riven holds her ground.


Her feet remain planted.


She is not driven backward.


For the first time,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
is forced away from her.


The figure is pushed backward
through the smoke.


Do not destroy it.

Do not end the fight.


Riven remains standing
with the empowered weapon in her hands.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
recovers at a distance.


Both opponents
face each other again.


Leave clear physical distance
between Riven and the figure.


The empowered weapon
remains fully active.


Riven is still injured
and breathing heavily.


She is not celebrating.


She simply realizes
that the fight has changed.


Hold only briefly.


CUT.


=== END STATE — IMPORTANT FOR NEXT SCENE ===

End the scene in a simple,
continuity-friendly combat state.

Riven is standing
and still holding the fully activated
emerald-green empowered weapon.

The empowered weapon remains active.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is still alive and intact.

The figure has been forced backward
and is now separated from Riven
by a clear fighting distance.

Riven and the figure
are facing each other.

Neither character is attacking
at the moment of the cut.

The final fight has not started yet.

Do not end with either character
on the ground.

Do not end during an attack.

Do not end with physical contact
between the characters.

CUT.、16:9
